lines.en: label day153:
scene thebird1
A couple of us are helping Molly move into her new dorm room today.
lines.zh: 今天我们有几个人在帮 Molly 搬进她的新宿舍。

lines.en: Tsuneyo wound up getting permission from her father to spend some nights here, so the two of them are going to be the first pair to move into the second floor of the dorms.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 好说歹说，总算得到了她父亲的许可，可以在这里过夜，所以她们俩将成为第一对搬进宿舍二楼的组合。

lines.en: Well, at least the second floor allotted to my students.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少是分配给我的学生的那层二楼。

lines.en: Apparently, I inherited the “misfit” class.
lines.zh: 看来，我接手的是一个「异类班」。

lines.en: Not because they’re actually misfits themselves, but because nearly every other girl in their grade is housed in the building directly next to this one.
lines.zh: 倒不是因为她们本人真的是什么异类，而是因为同年级其他女生几乎都住在紧挨着这栋楼的那栋里。

lines.en: Don’t ask me for an explanation as to why, though. I literally have no idea.
lines.zh: 不过别问我为什么。我是真的一点都不知道。

lines.en: : How long do you think it’s been up there?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它在上面待多久了？

lines.en: Ahh, and speaking of things that require an explanation, allow me to show you something-
lines.zh: 啊，说到需要解释一下的事情，请容我给你看个东西——

lines.en: scene thebird2
: Who knows? It seems pretty content, though.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？不过它看上去挺安分的。

lines.en: : You think so? It looks scared to me.
lines.zh: : 你这么觉得？我看它挺害怕的。

lines.en: : How? It’s literally just standing there.
lines.zh: : 哪儿害怕了？它就那么站在那儿而已。

lines.en: scene thebird3
: Yeah, but he’s out of his natural habitat! What would you do if you were used to living outside and then had to move into a girls’ dormitory?
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可它离开了自己原本的栖息地啊！要是你本来习惯住在外面，突然被塞进女生宿舍，你会怎么办？

lines.en: : Celebrate.
lines.zh: : 开香槟庆祝。

lines.en: scene thebird4
: Yeah...well, you’re stupid. I say we rescue the bird.
lines.zh: : 是吗……哼，你这人真蠢。我说我们得把这只鸟救下来。

lines.en: : How? You can’t even reach it.
lines.zh: : 怎么救？你连它都够不着。

lines.en: : No, but you can.
lines.zh: : 我够不着，但你能啊。

lines.en: : I’m not going to touch the bird. It probably has diseases or something.
lines.zh: : 我可不去碰那只鸟。它说不定带着什么病。

lines.en: : Maybe you {i}should{/i} touch it then.
lines.zh: : 那也许你{i}该{/i}去碰一下。

lines.en: scene thebird5
: Oh hey, Maya. I must have forgotten you were there since I haven’t been insulted in over two minutes.
lines.zh: : 哦，哟，Maya。我已经两分多钟没被你骂了，都快忘了你也在。

lines.en: scene thebird6
: I’m tired. I have to save my insults for when they’ll make the most impact.
lines.zh: : 我累了。我得把毒舌攒着，用在最有杀伤力的时候。

lines.en: : If you’re tired then why are you here? Shouldn’t you go downstairs and take a nap or something?
lines.zh: : 你累了那还待在这儿干嘛？不该下楼去睡个午觉什么的吗？

lines.en: : It’s too late in the day to nap. I’d just fall asleep for the entire night.
lines.zh: : 这会儿睡午觉太晚了。我一睡就得睡上一整晚。

lines.en: scene thebird7
: Besides...Molly is {i}technically{/i} a friend of mine and it would be rude for me to not assist given the circumstances.
lines.zh: : 再说……Molly {i}好歹也算{/i}我朋友，在这种情况下不来帮忙，未免太失礼了。

lines.en: : What circumstances?
lines.zh: : 什么情况？

lines.en: scene thebird6
: Being alone with you.
lines.zh: : 跟你单独相处。

lines.en: : That sounds terrifying and I don't want to subject her to that.
lines.zh: : 那听起来太可怕了，我可不想让她遭这种罪。

lines.en: : You’re alone with me all the time.
lines.zh: : 你可是天天都跟我在一起啊。

lines.en: : Not willingly.
lines.zh: : 那可不是我自愿的。

lines.en: : Can you two stop fighting for a second and help me restore order to nature?
lines.zh: : 你们俩能不能先停一秒，来帮我把自然的秩序恢复一下？

lines.en: scene thebird4
: Jeez, all I wanna do is save the poor little birdie and you guys feel the need to remind each other of your hate for one another.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我只是想救救那只可怜的小鸟，你们俩就非得互相提醒对方有多恨彼此。

lines.en: : Give it a rest already. We get it.
lines.zh: : 消停点吧。我们都知道了。

lines.en: : I don’t hate Maya at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不恨 Maya。

lines.en: : He’s right. I’m the one who hates him. Please keep him away from me.
lines.zh: : 他说得对。恨他的人是我。请让他离我远点。

lines.en: scene thebird8
: Ugh. Whatever, I’ll just figure out how to save it on my own.
lines.zh: : 呃。随便吧，我自己想办法救它就是了。

lines.en: : Go help Rin with boxes or something, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你去帮 Rin 搬搬箱子什么的吧。

lines.en: : Oh, right. We’re supposed to be moving things.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我们是来搬东西的。

lines.en: scene thebird9
: Kill me...
lines.zh: : 杀了我吧……

lines.en: : Hey, Rin. What’s the problem?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Rin。怎么了？

lines.en: : So many boxes. So little strength.
lines.zh: : 箱子那么多，力气那么小。

lines.en: : Here, let me take a few of those from you. I have a strange amount of experience when it comes to carrying boxes out of the dorm.
lines.zh: : 来，我帮你拿几个。我对「把箱子搬出宿舍」这件事，有着多得离谱的经验。

lines.en: scene thebird10
: No can do, Master! There is a strict no-boys-allowed policy when it comes to my personal belongings.
lines.zh: : 不行，主人！我的私人物品严格执行「男生禁止触碰」政策。

lines.en: : Ignoring that would cause your hands to turn black and fall off!
lines.zh: : 无视这条规矩，您的双手会发黑然后烂掉的！

lines.en: : Then why am I even here?
lines.zh: : 那我来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : Because you’re the protagonist! This is a scripted event that must occur if I’m ever to become the lead heroine!
lines.zh: : 因为您是主角啊！这是剧情事件，我要想当上第一女主角，这事儿就非发生不可！

lines.en: scene thebird11
: Wait, you’re shooting for the lead? The chuuni character never gets the lead role. You should know this.
lines.zh: : 等等，你志在第一女主？中二角色可从来拿不到女主的位子。你该不会不知道吧。

lines.en: scene thebird12
: That’s not true. Rikka got the lead in the Chuunibyou series.
lines.zh: : 才不是。Rikka 在《中二病》系列里就是女主。

lines.en: : That one literally has Chuunibyou in the title. That doesn't count.
lines.zh: : 那部片名里就明明白白写着「中二病」。这不算。

lines.en: : What the fuck are you two even talking about?
lines.zh: : 你俩到底在说些什么鬼东西？

lines.en: scene thebird13
: Oh, sorry! Time for another weebnote!
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉！又到了御宅小注释时间！

lines.en: : Awesome. I’m sure all of our imaginary fans will love this.
lines.zh: : 太好了。我相信我们那些臆想出来的粉丝一定爱听。

lines.en: : Chuunibyou is the term given to the behavior of characters who act in overdramatic and often embarrassing ways!
lines.zh: : 中二病，是用来形容角色做出过度夸张、常常令人难为情的行为的术语！

lines.en: : You mean like how you act literally every day?
lines.zh: : 你是指你每天的日常表现吗？

lines.en: : Exactly like that! It’s what makes me lovable and you will come to appreciate it in due time, Sir.
lines.zh: : 正是如此！这正是我惹人疼爱的地方，您迟早会懂得欣赏它的，长官。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, didn’t you say something in class about how Rin was like...the commander of the undead or something?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你上课时是不是说过 Rin 是什么……不死者的指挥官之类的？

lines.en: : Does she have this chuunibyou thing, too?
lines.zh: : 她也有这个中二病吗？

lines.en: scene thebird14
: N-N-Not as bad as Molly has it! I'm just a normal dork who does dorky things! It's not bad enough to label it with an actual condition!
lines.zh: : 才、才没有 Molly 那么严重！我只是个会干些傻事的普通笨蛋！还没严重到能挂上一种正经病名的地步！

lines.en: : You have fallen just as far into the darkness as I have and you know it.
lines.zh: : 你和我一样深陷黑暗之中，你自己心里清楚。

lines.en: scene thebird16
: I have not! And stop bringing up my secret life when we’re not in the club room anymore! I’m begging you!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！还有，别在我们不在社团活动室的时候提我的秘密生活了！求你了！

lines.en: : Everywhere is a club room when you are unable to exhibit self-control.
lines.zh: : 当你无法自我约束时，处处都是社团活动室。

lines.en: scene thebird17
: But I guess there {i}are{/i} more pressing matters at hand right now. Right, Captain?
lines.zh: : 不过眼下还{i}有{/i}更紧迫的事情要处理。对吧，船长？

lines.en: : Captain. Master. Sensei. Sir. Can you just pick one already, Molly?
lines.zh: : 船长。主人。老师。长官。Molly，你能不能就挑一个？

lines.en: : I have too many names now and it’s confusing me.
lines.zh: : 我现在名字太多了，都把我给搞晕了。

lines.en: : Sir yes, Sir. You will henceforth be known as Supreme Overlord Sensei, Herald of the Adolescents.
lines.zh: : 是的，长官！从今往后，您就叫做至高霸主 Sensei，青春期的先驱者。

lines.en: That’s somehow even worse than having four names.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，这比有四个名字还糟糕。

lines.en: : Molly, come to think of it, how come you’re making Rin carry all of your stuff?
lines.zh: : Molly，话说回来，你干嘛让 Rin 一个人搬你所有的东西？

lines.en: : We came all the way here to help {i}you{/i} out, but I don’t think I’ve seen you actually do anything so far.
lines.zh: : 我们大老远跑来是帮{i}你{/i}的，可我到目前为止好像没见你动过一根手指。

lines.en: : I can assure you that there is a perfectly acceptable reason for that.
lines.zh: : 我可以向您保证，这是有完全说得通的理由的。

lines.en: : Okay...And what’s the reason?
lines.zh: : 好啊……那理由是？

lines.en: scene thebird18
: You see...I expelled the majority of my power during a fight with an ancient wizard earlier today and am now only able to use 5%% of my total strength.
lines.zh: : 您看……今天早些时候我和一位远古巫师一战，耗尽了大部分力量，现在只能使出全盛时期 5%% 的实力。

lines.en: : You said your reason was acceptable. I’ve been deceived.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说这理由「说得通」。我被骗了。

lines.en: scene thebird19
: Okay, fine. I am very weak, Sir.
lines.zh: : 好吧好吧。我确实很虚弱，长官。

lines.en: : My fragile Irish arms can’t even carry a sack o’ potatoes up the stairs.
lines.zh: : 我这双脆弱的爱尔兰胳膊，连一麻袋土豆都搬不上楼梯。

lines.en: : Why would you ever need to do that?...
lines.zh: : 你干嘛非得搬土豆啊？……

lines.en: : I thought the Irish were supposed to be tough? You know...that whole {i}fightin’ Irish{/i} stereotype and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我还以为爱尔兰人应该很硬朗呢？就是那个……{i}「战斗的爱尔兰人」{/i}之类的刻板印象。

lines.en: scene thebird20
: Sir, this may come as a shock to you, but I don’t go outside all that much.
lines.zh: : 长官，这话也许会让您震惊，但我不怎么出门。

lines.en: : That doesn't come as a shock at all, actually.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我一点也不震惊。

lines.en: : The result of my inability to exercise has, for lack of a better term- turned my muscles into mashed potatoes.
lines.zh: : 由于我缺乏锻炼，恕我找不到更贴切的说法——我的肌肉已经变成了土豆泥。

lines.en: : Are you really going to make potato references every chance you get?
lines.zh: : 你真打算逮着机会就往土豆上扯？

lines.en: : Probably, Supreme Overlord. That is simply the person I am.
lines.zh: : 大概吧，至高霸主。我就是这么个人。

lines.en: scene thebird22
: Oh, speaking of potatoes, do you still want to come bathing suit shopping with Futaba and me tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 哦，说到土豆，你明天还打算跟我和 Futaba 去买泳衣吗？

lines.en: : What does that have to do with potatoes?
lines.zh: : 这跟土豆有什么关系？

lines.en: : Nothing. I just need to know because I was supposed to respond to Futaba like half an hour ago.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我就是得确认一下，因为我半小时前就该回 Futaba 了。

lines.en: : Oh, umm...yeah. I can come, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦，嗯……好吧。我应该能去。

lines.en: : Are you not looking forward to the beach, Molly? That’s not really the excited sort of reaction I’d expect out of someone like you.
lines.zh: : Molly，你是不期待去海边吗？换作是你这样的人，我本以为反应会更兴奋一点。

lines.en: scene thebird24
: To be quite frank, Sir, I am utterly horrified. I’m not even sure if I’m going to survive this trip.
lines.zh: : 老实说，长官，我简直吓坏了。我甚至不确定自己能不能活着从这次旅行里回来。

lines.en: : That seems a little extreme.
lines.zh: : 这说得有点夸张了吧。

lines.en: : Supreme Overlord, take a good, long look at my body and tell me what you see.
lines.zh: : 至高霸主，请您好好地、仔细地端详一下我这副身体，然后告诉我您看到了什么。

lines.en: scene thebird25
: For the record, Molly...it would probably be best to, like...{i}not{/i} ask Sensei things like that.
lines.zh: : 我先说清楚啊，Molly……最好还是……{i}别问{/i} Sensei 那种问题。

lines.en: At least Rin understands me.
lines.zh: 至少 Rin 懂我。

lines.en: : Tell me, Supreme Overlord. Is this the body of someone who looks like she would fare well under the intense Kumon-mi sun?
lines.zh: : 请您告诉我，至高霸主。这副身体，看起来像是能在 Kumon-mi 的烈日下安然无恙的样子吗？

lines.en: : I will be a lobster in less than five minutes.
lines.zh: : 不到五分钟，我就会变成一只龙虾。

lines.en: : I don’t even know how to swim.
lines.zh: : 我连游泳都不会。

lines.en: : Then what the hell are you going to do at the beach?
lines.zh: : 那你到底去海滩上干嘛？

lines.en: scene thebird26
: Make memories that only girls my age are able to make! Live life to the fullest! Find the man who killed my father and avenge him!
lines.zh: : 去创造只有我这个年纪的女孩才能创造的回忆！尽情地享受人生！找出杀害我父亲的男人并为他报仇！

lines.en: : Your dad is still alive, though...
lines.zh: : 可你爸还活着啊……

lines.en: : That seems like a lot to do in one weekend.
lines.zh: : 一个周末要干这么多事，够呛的。

lines.en: : Thankfully, the backup plan is reading manga under an umbrella.
lines.zh: : 好在备用方案是撑着伞看漫画。

lines.en: : That sounds a lot more realistic.
lines.zh: : 这个听起来现实多了。

lines.en: : But if you’re looking for something a little more...beach-oriented, I could always teach you how to swim.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你想找点更……海滩一点的乐子，我倒是可以教你游泳。

lines.en: scene thebird27
: I...will respectfully decline! I am perfectly happy not knowing how to swim!
lines.zh: : 我……恕我恭敬地拒绝！不会游泳我也过得很好！

lines.en: : How are you that red already, Molly?...
lines.zh: : Molly，你怎么已经红成这样了？……

lines.en: : Irish skin! It reveals our true emotions even when we don’t want it to!
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰人的皮肤！就算我们不想，它也会把真实情绪暴露出来！

lines.en: : Are you really that embarrassed thinking about Sensei teaching you how to swim?
lines.zh: : 光是想想 Sensei 教你游泳，你就羞成这样？

lines.en: : Of course! That’s like, straight out of a dating-sim. I’m not yet prepared.
lines.zh: : 那当然！这简直就是恋爱模拟游戏里的桥段嘛。我还没准备好。

lines.en: : You know you're never going to be the lead heroine with that attitude, right?
lines.zh: : 你这种态度是当不上第一女主角的，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I need to go set more things up in my room!
lines.zh: : 我得回房间再多布置点东西！

lines.en: scene thebird28
Molly quickly vanishes into her dorm and I’m left in the hall with Rin and the others.
lines.zh: Molly 一溜烟钻进宿舍不见了，走廊上只剩下我和 Rin 她们。

lines.en: : She is certainly a character.
lines.zh: : 她可真是个活宝。

lines.en: : That’s an understatement. Molly lives in a world of her own.
lines.zh: : 这话说轻了。Molly 活在自己的世界里。

lines.en: : You'd think that with all the raunchy manga and h-games she plays that she'd be able to talk about touching another human without getting flushed, but...nope.
lines.zh: : 你以为她玩了那么多黄色漫画和 H 游戏，谈起碰别人的身体来总该面不改色了吧……结果并没有。

lines.en: : She straight up can't even talk about romance without getting like that either. It's wild.
lines.zh: : 她甚至一聊到恋爱也会变成那样。真是离谱。

lines.en: : Speaking of romance, are you excited to see Chika in a swimsuit?
lines.zh: : 说到恋爱，你期待看到 Chika 穿泳衣的样子吗？

lines.en: scene thebird29
: I’m going to actually die.
lines.zh: : 我真的要死了。

lines.en: : Do you have the hospital on speed dial? Because if not, you should definitely get on that.
lines.zh: : 你把医院的电话设成快捷拨号了吗？要是没有，你最好现在就去设一个。

lines.en: : Sure. Just for you, though. If anyone else asks me to call an ambulance, they’ll be shit out of luck.
lines.zh: : 行啊。不过只为你一个人。别人要我帮忙叫救护车，那他们就自求多福吧。

lines.en: : That’s kind of a horrible thing to say.
lines.zh: : 这话说的可真够缺德的。

lines.en: : I’m kind of a horrible person.
lines.zh: : 我这人本来就挺缺德的。

lines.en: scene thebird30
: The best horrible person.
lines.zh: : 是最棒的缺德鬼。

lines.en: Rin holds out her fist to me, expecting a fist bump.
lines.zh: Rin 朝我伸出拳头，等着我跟她碰拳。

lines.en: Instead of immediately reciprocating, which is what my heart tells me to do, I am faced with a troubling question.
lines.zh: 我心里想立刻回碰过去，可偏偏冒出了一个恼人的问题。

lines.en: : If I pound it right now, does that doom me to a life in the friend-zone?
lines.zh: : 如果我现在碰上去，是不是就注定要一辈子待在「朋友区」了？

lines.en: : Are you implying you’re not already in the friend-zone?
lines.zh: : 你这话的意思是，你还没在朋友区里？

lines.en: : I sure hope not.
lines.zh: : 我当然希望没有。

lines.en: : Flirting with me is a bold move when you know for a fact that I am undressing Chika with my mind right now.
lines.zh: : 你明知道我这会儿正在用眼神把 Chika 的衣服扒光，还敢跟我调情，胆子不小嘛。

lines.en: : Are you doing anything else at literally any point in your daily life?
lines.zh: : 你日常生活里到底还有没有别的事可做？

lines.en: : Only if another cute girl walks by. But then I default back to Chika the second they're gone.
lines.zh: : 只有走过一个可爱女生的时候才会有。但人家一走，我立刻又回到 Chika 身上。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得挺合理的。

lines.en: : Finish the fist bump, Sensei. These boxes are heavier than they look and you are leaving me hanging.
lines.zh: : 把碰拳碰完啊，Sensei。这些箱子比看起来重多了，你还让我在这儿举着。

lines.en: I bump Rin's fist, regardless of any possible consequences.
lines.zh: 不管后果如何，我还是跟 Rin 碰了拳。

lines.en: scene thebird31
: Welcome to the friend-zone, bud.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到朋友区，兄弟。

lines.en: : Don’t you fucking dare.
lines.zh: : 你他妈敢。

lines.en: scene thebird32
: Oh, come on! You know I’m kidding. We’re already more than just friends in my eyes.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样！你知道我在开玩笑的。在我看来我们早就不只是朋友了。

lines.en: : That's right. We're homies.
lines.zh: : 没错。我们是 homies。

lines.en: scene thebird33
: Ahh!
: Say it again! One more time!
lines.zh: : 再说一遍！再来一次！

lines.en: : We're homies.
lines.zh: : 我们是 homies。

lines.en: : One more! One more!
lines.zh: : 再来一次！再来一次！

lines.en: : ...Homies.
lines.zh: : ……Homies。

lines.en: scene thebird34
: Yes...YES!
lines.zh: : 对……对了！

lines.en: : I can feel my strength returning!
lines.zh: : 我感觉力量回来了！

lines.en: : To think that I'd be so easily swayed by hearing the words I have waited so long to hear!
lines.zh: : 没想到听到这句我盼了那么久的话，居然会这么容易就满足！

lines.en: : Excuse me, Sensei...But I must make use of this new found strength.
lines.zh: : 抱歉了，Sensei……我得把这股新生的力量用起来。

lines.en: : Until we meet again!
lines.zh: : 后会有期！

lines.en: scene black
Rin tries to open the door to Molly’s room but is unable to due to the amount of boxes she’s carrying.
lines.zh: Rin 想推开 Molly 的房门，可手上箱子太多，怎么也推不开。

lines.en: As such, I help push it open for her and she disappears inside...
lines.zh: 于是我帮她把门推开，她就这么消失在里面了……

lines.en: : How are you doing over here, Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami，你这边怎么样了？

lines.en: scene thebird8
: I can’t reach the bird and Maya won’t help.
lines.zh: : 我够不着那只鸟，Maya 又不肯帮忙。

lines.en: : Just leave it alone...
lines.zh: : 别管它了……

lines.en: : I’m with Maya on this. Just leave it alone. That bird lives here now.
lines.zh: : 这次我站 Maya。别管它了。那只鸟现在就住这儿了。

lines.en: : Give me five more minutes with it.
lines.zh: : 再给我五分钟跟它待会儿。

lines.en: scene black
Five minutes soon becomes half an hour as Rin and I carry the rest of Molly’s stuff upstairs.
lines.zh: 在 Rin 和我把 Molly 剩下的东西搬上楼的过程中，五分钟不知不觉变成了半小时。

lines.en: Thankfully, after arguing with her about it for a minute or two, Molly caved on her ‘no-boys’ policy and allowed me to actually help.
lines.zh: 好在跟她争了一两分钟之后，Molly 在「男生禁止」政策上松了口，允许我真正搭把手。

lines.en: And even though I’m not the type to normally go out of his way to be kind like this, it {i}is{/i} a little fun helping her move in.
lines.zh: 虽然我不是那种会特地绕路去做这种好事的人，但帮她搬家确实{i}有点意思{/i}。

lines.en: Especially knowing that I’ll be able to visit her sometime in the near future-
lines.zh: 尤其是想到不久的将来我还能去找她——

lines.en: And how determined she is to become a {i}heroine...{/i}
lines.zh: 还有她想当{i}女主角{/i}的决心有多坚定……

lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]！{/i}
